issue_request: FHIR-5966 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Structured Documents change request asking that Composition.section.content be moved before the nested Composition.section.section element.
initial_application: Git commit c5e4c8a2aa3483544ef4138d2295510606589c46 explicitly applied the request with the subject "Composition section content should come before a nested section 5966". The parent source had Composition.section.section before Composition.section.content in source/composition/composition-spreadsheet.xml; the commit reordered the primary rows so Composition.section.content came first.
additional_context: Current FHIR source no longer uses the DSTU1 element name Composition.section.content in the active Composition resource; the equivalent data reference is Composition.section.entry. source/fhir.ini actively includes composition=Composition, and source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml places Composition.section.entry before Composition.section.section. The legacy CDA profile still has Composition.section.content before Composition.section.section, but its fhir.ini profile entry is commented out.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active Composition StructureDefinition already satisfies the requested order under the current element name.
